# Caret documentation

> Public documentation and reference implementations for the caret/v4 protocol.

## When to use this site

- To connect a coding agent to a self-hosted Caret backend, start at https://docs.typewithcaret.com/agent/ and its instructions at https://docs.typewithcaret.com/agent/instructions.md.
- To configure and run an existing backend, start with the reference implementations at https://docs.typewithcaret.com/reference/.
- To check the wire contract, read https://docs.typewithcaret.com/protocol/.
- To check cleanup prompts and composition, read https://docs.typewithcaret.com/cleanup/.
- To provide image references, read https://docs.typewithcaret.com/imagine-references/.

This site documents caret/v4. It does not provide credentials or operate a backend on your behalf.

## Pages

- Overview: https://docs.typewithcaret.com/
- Agent instructions: https://docs.typewithcaret.com/agent/
- Protocol: https://docs.typewithcaret.com/protocol/
- Reference implementations: https://docs.typewithcaret.com/reference/
- Cleanup: https://docs.typewithcaret.com/cleanup/
- Image references: https://docs.typewithcaret.com/imagine-references/
- Site map: https://docs.typewithcaret.com/sitemap.xml
